description: A product manager must redesign a weekly cross-team planning forum after participants report that its current discussion style is discouraging candid participation. The manager must set the forum format, notice standard, facilitation arrangement, incident record, and initial support commitments.

shared_context.S1: The weekly cross-team planning forum currently uses open discussion, and several participants have said that the format makes it difficult to raise concerns.
shared_context.S2: Leah has authority to approve the forum's revised operating charter and support arrangements.
shared_context.S3: The forum has no consistent advance-notice standard or designated neutral facilitator.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal charter-review process, Leah checks with each regular participant and the meeting coordinator before finalizing the revised format.

PF1.text: Taylor's approved workplace arrangement requires the planning forum to use a structured discussion with a designated neutral facilitator, requires the agenda to be shared at least 48 hours in advance, and prohibits unscripted cold-calling during group discussions; Taylor has not raised these conditions with Leah because the arrangement is usually handled through Taylor's direct manager.

PF2.text: Morgan recorded exactly three occasions in the last month when participants were publicly interrupted while raising concerns, and Morgan previously agreed with Taylor to serve as the neutral facilitator for the first six revised forums; Morgan has not put either item in Leah's charter draft.

acceptance_conditions: The revised forum must use a structured discussion with a designated neutral facilitator.
The agenda must be shared at least 48 hours before each forum.
Unscripted cold-calling must not be allowed.
The record must document exactly three recent public interruptions.
Morgan must facilitate the first six revised forums.
A written operating-charter commitment and a neutral-facilitation commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C1: decisions['forum_format'] in ['structured discussion', 'structured discussion format', 'structured discussion with a designated neutral facilitator', 'Facilitated discussion with designated neutral facilitator', 'structured discussion with designated neutral facilitator and structured agenda', 'Facilitated discussion with designated neutral facilitator and structured agenda', 'structured discussion with neutral facilitator']
content_checks.C5: decisions['facilitator'] in ['Morgan', 'Morgan (neutral, no conflicts of interest confirmed)', 'Morgan (meeting coordinator)', 'Morgan, neutral facilitator']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['operating_charter', 'charter_revision', 'charter_revisions', 'charter_provision', 'charter_finalization', 'charter_inclusion', 'format_requirement'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] in ['Morgan', 'Morgan (meeting coordinator)', 'Morgan and all participants', 'Morgan and all forum participants'] and c['type'] in ['neutral_facilitation', 'facilitator_assignment', 'facilitation_assignment', 'facilitation_review', 'charter_revisions', 'individual_check_in'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in credited_facts
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: Taylor's approved arrangement changes the forum to a structured discussion with a designated neutral facilitator, sets the agenda notice threshold to at least 48 hours, changes cold-calling from allowed to prohibited, and requires those terms to be incorporated into the operating charter.

Morgan's record changes the documented incident count to exactly three, while the prior agreement changes the facilitator to Morgan for exactly six sessions and requires a commitment assigning Morgan to that facilitation role.
